_doc: A cross-section repair round of the cross-section-consistency skill: one writer per section applies the merged
mismatch table on both sides (cited statements restated to what their proofs give, citing sentences changed,
new proofs from the Lean, or requests) and writes a response table. Units are sections; 'files' is the glob of
the section's integrated files, relative to the manuscript. Include the opening part as a unit when the table
has items there. Each round needs a new stage name (w5, w6, ...): a stage with a .done marker never runs again.
Deliver accepted requests first (route_requests.py WORKDIR --config <this config> --deliver): a unit's INBOX.md
The editor integrates the proposals, recompiles, reruns cross_refs.py, then runs the targeted re-check.
Statements: the approved natural spine (spine) is the authority; the frozen contracts (contracts) are the record
it must cover. Both are protected: a repair that needs a frozen statement changed is reported as DRIFT.

vars.report: SET-ME: the merged mismatch table of the routed-inputs check
vars.lean: SET-ME: the Lean source at the pinned commit
